items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I prize those records I've got of him and Garvin Bouchelle on clarinet. Yeah. Yeah. Did you keep in touch with Hotline Records or what, the scene over here? Because you've heard of these guys.

ctx.x: Did you play with him? I met him. Well, and I didn't play with him, but I heard him play. He had that long trumpet, you know. He was a good showman. He was a good showman.
I prize those records I've got of him and Garvin Bouchelle on clarinet. Yeah. Yeah. Did you keep in touch with Hotline Records or what, the scene over here? Because you've heard of these guys.
Well, I used to belong to the, while I was over there, I belonged to the Hot Club of France and was traveling. Was that Pernacier's?
